skills.name: creative-problem-solving
skills.description: Generates genuinely non-obvious options for an open-ended problem by running successive constrained passes that each refuse the previous one's move, rather than one brainstorm. Use when the user wants ideas, options, angles, approaches, a new model or strategy, help getting unstuck, a rethink of something from scratch, non-obvious ways to improve a product, process or tool they maintain — including when they say they are out of ideas — or says brainstorm / ideate / what are my options / think outside the box / SCAMPER / TRIZ / first principles / biomimicry / lateral thinking. Runs a fast pass or a deeper researched pass, and separates novelty claims from feasibility judgements. Not for problems with one correct answer, or for executing an idea already chosen.
